structure_recovery.identity_mapping: system_1/complex_1 = Br = CCDC 2453269; system_2/complex_2 = Cl = CCDC 2453268. Do not infer system order from ascending record numbers.
structure_recovery.deterministic_transformation: Read each supplied immutable CIF, verify its internal archive ID, formula and element set before calculation, select the asymmetric unit containing one Cu, one tridentate ligand and one NCS group, preserve deposited identity/stereochemistry, terminate only the chain bond needed for an isolated monomer, and report the edit and charge. If a CIF does not match the declared complex identity, report a bounded identity failure and do not alter the file.

state_validation_policy: Check electron-count parity before calculation. Preserve any non-executable source state as a diagnostic failure and keep parity-compatible repaired-state results separate; never relabel a repaired result as the source state.
